run_bench: run the bench function to benchmark a callable with configurable iterations and warmup
run_grad_f: run the grad function from functorch to compute the gradient of f
run_make_fx: run make_fx to trace a gradient function into an FX graph representation
run_nnc_jit: run nnc_jit to compile a gradient function with NNC JIT optimization
run_f: run the f function to compute the sum of torch.sin on a tensor
